text:
Type: white wall shelf with hooks
Use: displaying jars and decor, hanging cups, keys or towels; kitchen, dining room, hallway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted wood, small metal hooks
Colors: white, silver hooks
Shape: long slim shelf on two curved corbel brackets, a rail with a row of small hooks under the front edge, soft rounded corners, light and wall-hugging
Feel: fresh, homely, practical, gentle
Goes with: white tiles, light wood, stoneware, linen; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian kitchens and dining rooms
